userStories.title: Doctor Future and Historical Consultation Schedules
userStories.story: As a doctor, I want to view all upcoming future schedules and previous completed appointments with patient details and meeting links so that I can plan ahead and review patient history.
acceptanceCriteria: The doctor portal shall provide direct navigation to Today Schedule, Future Schedules, and Previous Schedules.
Future Schedules shall display upcoming consultation dates, time slots, patient names, and meeting links.
Previous Schedules shall list past completed consultations along with patient ratings and review feedback.
Doctors shall be able to filter schedules in real time using the interactive period tabs and search bar.

acceptanceCriteria: Verify that patient can successfully complete the flow for Booking an appointment for dentist.

userStories.title: Account registration
userStories.story: As a patient I want to create an account in the healthcare application
acceptanceCriteria: The system shall accept patient name, contact email, and phone number.
The system shall prevent duplicate registration with the same email.
Successful registration immediately activates patient dashboard session.

userStories.title: Patient Registration and Profile Initialization
userStories.story: As a new patient, I want to create an account with my basic personal information so that I can schedule medical consultations.
acceptanceCriteria: The system shall accept patient name, contact email, and valid phone number.
The system shall prevent duplicate registration with the same contact identifier.
The patient profile shall be stored in the database with an initial unverified status until first login.
A confirmation greeting and default profile dashboard shall be displayed upon successful creation.

userStories.title: Patient Google OAuth Login
userStories.story: As a registered patient, I want to log in using my Google account so that I can securely and seamlessly access my patient portal without remembering extra passwords.
acceptanceCriteria: Clicking 'Login As A Patient' shall initiate the Google OAuth 2.0 authorization sequence.
The system shall decode the JWT token (sub, name, email, picture) using the configured algorithm.
A valid token shall transition the patient to the Patient Dashboard (/patient).
If Google authentication fails or is cancelled, a clear error notification shall be rendered without system crash.

userStories.title: Search and Browse Doctors by Specialty
userStories.story: As a patient, I want to search and filter doctors by medical specialization (e.g. Cardiology, Dermatology, Pathology) so that I find the right healthcare specialist for my symptoms.
acceptanceCriteria: The search bar shall support case-insensitive autocomplete matching doctor specialization and name.
Matching doctor cards shall display full name, specialty, phone contact, and consultation fee per session.
A 'Book' call-to-action button shall be visible on each qualified doctor card.
If no doctor matches the query, a friendly 'No specialist found' fallback message shall be shown.

userStories.title: Doctor Consultation Date Selection
userStories.story: As a patient, I want to browse an interactive calendar and pick a future consultation date so that I can schedule a visit at my convenience.
acceptanceCriteria: The calendar shall visually disable and disallow selection of past dates.
Clicking a valid future date shall highlight the day and persist the chosen date string (YYYY-MM-DD).
A 'Confirm And Go to Next Step' button shall remain disabled until a valid date is picked.
Navigating forward shall transition the user to the Slot Selection screen.

userStories.title: Time Slot Selection & Collision Prevention
userStories.story: As a patient, I want to view available consultation slots (09:00:00, 12:00:00, 15:00:00) for my selected doctor and date, and book an open slot so that I am assured consultation time.
acceptanceCriteria: The system shall query the doctor's dateSchedule and display slot statuses in real time.
Available slots shall display an active 'Book Slot' button.
Already booked slots (isBooked = true) shall be disabled or clearly marked as unavailable.
Selecting an open slot shall temporarily reserve it and proceed to the Payment stage.

userStories.title: Consultation Fee Payment Checkout
userStories.story: As a patient, I want to pay the consultation fee through a secure online payment interface so that my appointment booking is officially confirmed.
acceptanceCriteria: The payment receipt shall itemize Doctor Name, Specialization, Consultation Fee, Tax, and Grand Total.
Clicking 'Pay Now' shall launch the secured payment dialog.
The system shall validate postal code and test card numbers before processing transaction.
Upon successful charge, an appointment record shall be written to the database with a transaction identifier.

userStories.title: Virtual Meeting Link Generation & Appointment Confirmation
userStories.story: As a patient, I want to receive an appointment confirmation with a Google Meet or teleconsultation link so that I can join the remote doctor consultation.
acceptanceCriteria: Upon successful slot booking and payment, a unique teleconsultation link shall be associated with the appointment.
The link shall appear under 'Appointment Status' on the Patient Dashboard.
Clicking 'Join Meet' shall open the secure meeting in a new browser tab.
The consultation status shall reflect 'Scheduled' and sync with the doctor's agenda.

userStories.title: Appointment History & Status Tracking
userStories.story: As a patient, I want to view a chronological history of my previous appointments and active bookings so that I can keep track of my medical history.
acceptanceCriteria: The 'Appointment Status' sub-interface shall show current/upcoming appointments with date, time, and doctor name.
The 'Previous Appointments' sub-interface shall display past appointments with consultation dates.
Patients shall have an option to navigate to doctor feedback from past appointment entries.

userStories.title: Patient Feedback & Star Rating Submission
userStories.story: As a patient, I want to submit a 1 to 5 star rating and written review for a completed consultation so that I can evaluate the care provided.
acceptanceCriteria: A feedback form shall be accessible only for previous appointments that have concluded.
The form shall accept a star rating between 1 and 5, a feedback title, and detailed review text.
Submitting feedback shall update the appointment record (`feedback.given = true`, `feedback.stars = X`).
A patient cannot submit duplicate feedback for the same completed appointment.

userStories.title: Patient Contact Phone Number Update
userStories.story: As a patient, I want to update my contact phone number on my profile so that doctors and hospital staff can reach me in case of urgent consultation rescheduling.
acceptanceCriteria: The phone update sub-interface shall validate the phone number to be a valid 10-digit format.
Submitting a valid number shall issue a PUT request to /patients/update-phone.
The profile view shall immediately reflect the updated phone number.
Invalid or empty phone inputs shall display inline validation error messages.

userStories.title: Doctor Secure Credential Login
userStories.story: As a medical doctor, I want to authenticate using my clinical username and password so that I can access my daily appointments and patient schedule.
acceptanceCriteria: The Doctor Login page (/doctorlogin) shall accept username and password.
Entering valid credentials (e.g. username 'test', password 'test') shall return a signed JWT token.
The token shall be stored in localStorage and user redirected to Doctor Dashboard (/doctor).
Submitting incorrect credentials shall show 'wrong username or password' without revealing account existence.

userStories.title: Doctor Today's Consultation Schedule View
userStories.story: As a doctor, I want to view a timeline of all patient appointments scheduled for today so that I can prepare for my consultations.
acceptanceCriteria: The dashboard shall display Today's Schedule with Date, Time Slot, Patient Name, and Meet Link.
Consultations shall be ordered chronologically by slot time (09:00, 12:00, 15:00).
If no appointments are booked for today, a clear 'No appointments scheduled today' message shall appear.
Clicking 'Join Meet' shall open the respective patient's virtual meeting.

userStories.title: Doctor Profile & Fee Management
userStories.story: As a doctor, I want to inspect and update my personal details, phone number, medical specialty, and consultation fee per session so that patients see current information.
acceptanceCriteria: The 'Personal Details' view shall display Doctor Name, Specialization, Phone Number, and Fees Per Session.
Updating fees or contact info shall persist to the database via /doctors/update.
Updated consultation fees shall immediately apply to future patient slot bookings.

userStories.title: Doctor Appointment History & Earnings Summary
userStories.story: As a doctor, I want to review previous appointments and track total revenue earned from completed sessions so that I can manage my practice finances.
acceptanceCriteria: The 'Previous Appointments' view shall list all completed patient sessions.
Each entry shall show consultation date, patient name, slot time, and feedback score.
The interface shall aggregate total earnings based on completed appointments and doctor session fee.

userStories.title: Doctor Patient Feedback Inspection
userStories.story: As a doctor, I want to inspect detailed patient reviews and star ratings for each past appointment so that I can improve my bedside manner and clinical service.
acceptanceCriteria: The feedback column in Previous Appointments shall render star icons corresponding to the rating.
Clicking on feedback details shall navigate to /doctor/feedback/:id.
The page shall render the review title, detailed narrative, and patient identity.

userStories.title: Admin Doctor Onboarding & Credential Verification
userStories.story: As a hospital administrator, I want to register and verify new doctors in the hospital database so that only licensed medical professionals can accept appointments.
acceptanceCriteria: The system shall accept doctor username, encrypted password, full name, phone, specialization, and session fee.
Upon creation via /doctors/add, initial appointment slot templates shall be initialized.
System shall enforce uniqueness of doctor username across the platform.
Newly registered doctors shall immediately appear in the patient doctor search directory.

userStories.title: Role-Based Access Control and Unauthorized Route Protection
userStories.story: As a security administrator, I want unauthenticated or unauthorized users to be denied access to clinical portals (/doctor, /patient) so that sensitive medical records remain confidential.
acceptanceCriteria: Navigating directly to /doctor without a valid doctor JWT shall redirect immediately to /doctorlogin.
A patient JWT token shall not grant access to doctor-only endpoints (/doctors/update, /doctor).
Tampered, expired, or malformed JWT tokens shall be rejected with 401 Unauthorized.
Logging out shall clear localStorage tokens and invalidate the client session.

testCases.userStoryTitle: Doctor Future and Historical Consultation Schedules
testCases.title: Doctor Future and Historical Consultation Schedules - Mid-Transaction Network Interruption & Rollback
testCases.description: Verify that an abrupt client disconnect or network timeout during a state-modifying action releases reserved locks and restores previous state.
preconditions: User starts multi-step consultation reservation flow

steps.action: Reserve temporary slot and proceed to confirmation dialog
steps.expectedResult: Slot unavailable to other clients during lock duration

steps.action: Simulate network timeout / browser tab closure before confirmation
steps.expectedResult: Confirmation handshake fails to complete within TTL window

steps.action: Check slot status after lock expiration (TTL)
steps.expectedResult: Slot reverts to isBooked: false; no ghost appointment created

testCases.expectedResult: System avoids orphaned bookings and preserves schedule hygiene.

testCases.userStoryTitle: Doctor Future and Historical Consultation Schedules
testCases.title: Doctor Future and Historical Consultation Schedules - Concurrent Execution & Race Condition Defense
testCases.description: Verify that simultaneous operations (e.g. concurrent slot bookings or rapid multiple button clicks) maintain data consistency without duplicates.
preconditions: Target healthcare resource is in a ready, open state
Two concurrent clients ready to dispatch simultaneous requests

steps.action: Dispatch Client A request for resource reservation
steps.expectedResult: Server accepts Request A and initiates transaction

steps.action: Dispatch Client B request for identical resource within 50ms window
steps.expectedResult: Database locking / atomic update evaluates conflict

steps.action: Evaluate server responses for both requests
steps.expectedResult: Exactly one request succeeds (HTTP 200); the competing request is cleanly rejected (HTTP 409 Conflict)

testCases.expectedResult: System guarantees isolation; zero double-booking or state duplication occurs.

promptExperiments.targetStoryTitle: Patient books an appointment with a doctor
promptExperiments.systemPrompt: You are a test case generator. Write test cases for the user story provided.
promptExperiments.userPrompt: Generate test cases for: As a patient, I want to book an appointment with a doctor so that I can receive a consultation.
promptExperiments.rawResponse:
Test Case 1: Book Appointment
Step 1: Open website
Step 2: Click book appointment
Step 3: Select doctor
Step 4: Click confirm
Expected: Appointment is booked.

Test Case 2: Cancel Appointment
Step 1: Click cancel
Expected: Appointment cancelled.
promptExperiments.whatChanged: Baseline prompt with zero domain instructions, no persona, and unstructured prompt text.
promptExperiments.whyItChanged: Initial baseline to measure what off-the-shelf LLMs produce without prompt engineering. It produced only 2 vague tests, had no preconditions, omitted negative scenarios, and completely missed healthcare domain realities (time slots, doctor schedules, booking collisions).
promptExperiments.keyFindings: Naive zero-shot prompting leads to severe under-specification and QA hallucinations (assuming arbitrary one-click booking without slot checks).

promptExperiments.targetStoryTitle: Patient books an appointment with a doctor
promptExperiments.systemPrompt: You are a Senior Healthcare QA Engineer specializing in hospital management software, EHR systems, and HIPAA compliance.
promptExperiments.userPrompt: As a patient, I want to book an appointment with a doctor so that I can receive a consultation. Generate positive and negative test cases including preconditions and step-by-step actions.
promptExperiments.rawResponse:
TC-01: Successful Appointment Booking (Positive)
Preconditions: Patient is logged in, doctor has available schedule.
Steps: 1. Go to search doctor; 2. Choose doctor; 3. Pick date; 4. Pick time slot; 5. Pay fee.
Expected: Appointment confirmed.

TC-02: Booking when no slots are free (Negative)
Preconditions: Doctor schedule has all slots booked.
Steps: 1. Select doctor; 2. Select date.
Expected: Error shown that doctor is unavailable.
promptExperiments.whatChanged: Added QA persona ('Senior Healthcare QA Engineer') and requested explicit positive and negative test cases with preconditions.
promptExperiments.whyItChanged: Addressing lack of test categorization and missing preconditions from Iteration 1. The persona immediately elicited negative testing (no slots free) and recognized doctor schedule availability.
promptExperiments.keyFindings: Role grounding significantly improves test mindset, but output format remains non-standardized and lacks boundary edge cases.

promptExperiments.targetStoryTitle: Patient books an appointment with a doctor
promptExperiments.systemPrompt: You are an automated test designer. Return ONLY a valid JSON array of test cases conforming exactly to the provided schema.
promptExperiments.userPrompt: User Story: US-PAT-005 Patient books appointment. Given the reference JSON schema with testId, title, scenarioType, preconditions, and steps array, generate 4 test cases.
promptExperiments.whatChanged: Introduced strict JSON schema specification and two few-shot examples demonstrating step arrays with testData and expectedResult.
promptExperiments.whyItChanged: Unstructured plain text cannot be directly executed by automation runners like Playwright. Few-shot formatting forced machine-parseable JSON with 100% syntactic conformity.
promptExperiments.keyFindings: Few-shot examples with strict JSON output eliminate parsing errors and guarantee deterministic step schema.

promptExperiments.targetStoryTitle: Patient books an appointment with a doctor
promptExperiments.systemPrompt: You are a Principal Healthcare Software Test Architect. Before outputting test cases, perform step-by-step reasoning on: 1) Medical safety risks; 2) Concurrent race conditions (e.g. two patients booking 09:00:00 simultaneously); 3) Payment session drop-offs; 4) Timezone and past date constraints. Then output structured JSON test cases covering Positive, Negative, and Edge Cases.
promptExperiments.userPrompt: Generate a comprehensive test suite for US-PAT-005 (Time Slot Selection & Collision Prevention) targeting our MERN healthcare application.
promptExperiments.rawResponse:
THINKING REASONING:
1. Medical safety: An unconfirmed appointment could lead to missed medical care.
2. Concurrency: Two patients viewing 09:00:00 simultaneously can trigger double booking unless atomic updates lock the slot.
3. Edge cases: Past dates, leap days, network timeouts during Stripe payment.
TEST CASES:
Generated 6 test cases: Happy path booking, Concurrent double booking rejection, Past date restriction, Payment timeout slot release, Autocomplete specialty miss, and Slot status persistence.
promptExperiments.whatChanged: Integrated Chain-of-Thought (CoT) reasoning phase explicitly asking the LLM to analyze concurrency collisions and clinical edge cases before generating tests.
promptExperiments.whyItChanged: Addressing subtle healthcare bugs where two patients book the same doctor slot at 09:00:00. CoT compelled the model to generate concurrency edge-case tests with atomic locking assertions.
promptExperiments.keyFindings: Chain-of-Thought prompting drastically increases edge-case discovery (from 0 edge cases in Iteration 1 to 3 deep concurrency edge cases in Iteration 4).

promptExperiments.whyItChanged: Eliminated the hallucinated drag-and-drop calendar from Iteration 5. Grounding the prompt in the exact codebase yielded tests that directly mirror real backend behavior.

promptExperiments.targetStoryTitle: Doctor logs in and manages schedule
promptExperiments.promptStrategy: CoT Edge Case & Defensive State Enforcement
promptExperiments.systemPrompt: You are a Principal Test Automation Architect. Analyze doctor schedule edge cases: 1) Doctor with zero appointments booked for today; 2) Doctor session expired while on schedule view; 3) Meet link generation failure. Generate comprehensive JSON test cases.
promptExperiments.userPrompt: Generate test suite covering US-DOC-002 (Today's Consultation Schedule) with full positive, negative, and edge-case coverage.
promptExperiments.rawResponse: Generated 5 test cases including: Empty schedule state graceful fallback, active meet link launch with noopener noreferrer, token expiry auto-logout, and multi-slot sequential order verification.

promptExperiments.whyItChanged: Replaced generic OWASP tests with healthcare-specific authorization tests to protect confidential patient and doctor data.
promptExperiments.keyFindings: Matrix-guided prompt structures prevent permission leakage and produce test cases that directly assert on HTTP 401/403 and client redirects.

promptExperiments.promptStrategy: Adversarial Token Tampering & Session Hijacking CoT
promptExperiments.systemPrompt: You are a Principal Security Test Architect for HIPAA-regulated platforms. Reason step-by-step through: 1) Malformed JWT signature injection; 2) LocalStorage token tampering (changing role payload); 3) Concurrent multi-tab session expiration; 4) CSRF and CORS origin spoofing. Generate executable test cases with exact assertions.
promptExperiments.userPrompt: Generate advanced security test suite for US-SEC-001 covering adversarial access attempts against the healthcare backend and frontend.
promptExperiments.rawResponse:
Generated 6 test cases:
1. Malformed JWT signature rejection on /doctors/update
2. Tampered payload doctor ID spoofing
3. Unauthenticated direct URL navigation guard
4. Patient token cross-role invocation block
5. LocalStorage clearing on logout
6. Expired token automated session revoking
promptExperiments.whatChanged: Combined adversarial security scenarios (signature tampering, ID spoofing, cross-role token replay) with CoT reasoning and concrete status assertions.
promptExperiments.whyItChanged: Ensuring compliance with healthcare data protection standards (HIPAA security rule). High-level prompts miss cryptographic and token manipulation vectors.
promptExperiments.keyFindings: Adversarial CoT prompting produces enterprise-grade penetration and authorization test suites capable of uncovering cryptographic and state vulnerabilities.
